newsitem.title: FRANCE: Left wins French election - final result.
newsitem.headline: Left wins French election - final result.

text.p: The combined left won France's general election and will have 318 seats in the 577-member National Assembly, according to official final results published by the Interior Ministry on Monday.

The Socialists and allied other-left candidates won 273 seats, the Communist party 38, ecologists seven, the outgoing centre-right coalition and other-right candidates 257, the extreme-right National Front one and there was on independent elected.
The turnout on Sunday's decisive second round was 71.07 percent.
Within the left, the Socialists will be by far the largest party with 240 seats on its own. On the right, the Gaullist RPR party won 135 seats and the centrist UDF 108.
The conservative coalition had held 464 seats in the outgoing Assembly.
